## Prepare transactions in Xero

The only thing in this skill that writes to Xero, and all it ever does is
create new unreconciled transactions so the user can tick them off. It
never marks anything reconciled, never edits an existing record, and never
deletes one.

Every row is checked again here: accepted by name, from the latest review,
not already created, not flagged for a person, outside every Xero lock date,
and hashing to exactly what the user saw when they accepted it. Anything
else is refused and reported rather than quietly skipped.

If Xero does not answer, nothing is retried blind. The next run looks the
references up first.

const input = $('Effective Read Connection').first().json;
return [{ json: { ...input, response: { ok: false, error: { code: input.readProblem === 'organisation-mismatch' ? 'XERO_ORGANISATION_MISMATCH' : 'READ_NOT_CONNECTED', message: input.readProblem === 'organisation-mismatch' ? 'The read-only and write credentials point at different Xero organisations, so nothing was created.' : 'The read-only Xero catalogue could not be rechecked, so nothing was created.' }, nextStep: 'The accepted suggestions are still saved. Fix only the Xero (read-only) credential and check again; do not retry preparation until both credentials refer to the same organisation.' } } }];
